description: This bar chart illustrates the GPU memory usage, in gigabytes (GB), for different fine-tuning methods. The horizontal axis displays the method categories: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA, and Ours, listed alphabetically. The vertical axis represents GPU Memory, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60 GB, with tick labels at 0, 20, 40, and 60. Each method is represented by a single orange bar, except for “Ours”, which is represented by a green bar. The “Full FT” bar is the tallest, reaching approximately 54 GB, while the “QLoRA” bar is the shortest, reaching approximately 8 GB. The “MTL-FT” bar reaches approximately 42 GB, the “TAG” bar reaches approximately 35 GB, the “LoRA” bar reaches approximately 22 GB, and the “Ours” bar reaches approximately 25 GB. No bars are visually emphasized, and the bars are arranged alphabetically along the horizontal axis.
